lines.text: Your MacBook can feel your heartbeat. Kind of.
Rest your wrists on it, and the whole laptop leans. About one and a half thousandths of a g.
There's a hidden motion sensor in there, reading eight hundred times a second.
Every beat of your heart gives your body a tiny kick. We try to catch it.
Some days the rhythm shows up. Honestly? Most days, the desk wins.
MacBook Heartbeat. Open source, and very experimental.
